basics.name: Thinh Nguyen Nhu
basics.label: Mechatronics Engineer & AI Researcher
basics.summary: As a science-oriented person, my long-term vision is to develop intelligent systems and structures that learn from the fundamental principles of physics, biology, and engineering. My research interests focus on applied machine learning, particularly Physics-Informed Machine Learning (PIML) and Generative AI for scientific discovery and inverse problems. My ultimate goal is to build physics-grounded AI models that enable the understanding, design, and control of next-generation smart structures.

location.address: Hanoi University of Science and Technology

work.name: AiRA Lab, HUST
work.summary: Investigate Physics-Informed Machine Learning (PIML) methods for scientific and engineering applications.
highlights: Investigate Physics-Informed Machine Learning (PIML) methods for scientific and engineering applications.
Develop PINN architectures for multi-solution inverse design of Kresling origami structures.
Implement PINN-based frameworks for structural analysis and design optimization of composite laminates.

work.name: Origami Technology Lab, HUST
work.summary: Modeled nonlinear dynamic behaviors of Kresling origami and formulated PINN algorithms.
highlights: Modeled nonlinear dynamic behaviors of Kresling origami and constructed bifurcation diagrams under harmonic excitation.
Formulated Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) algorithms for the inverse design of Kresling structures as part of undergraduate thesis research.

work.name: Project XYaZ Lab, HUST
work.summary: Dynamics modeling and trajectory-tracking of parallel mechanisms.
highlights: Modeled and simulated the dynamics of a 3-RRR planar parallel robot using MATLAB/Simulink.
Evaluated trajectory-tracking algorithms for parallel mechanisms.
